narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed across Middle Tennessee during the afternoon and evening hours on July 17. Heavy rainfall from these thunderstorms led to some localized flooding reports.
ev: Rabbit Trail Road was closed due to flooding and a culvert being washed out.
A low water bridge was flooded and impassable at Bishop Chapel Road near Sweet Home Road.
Two vehicles that drove into flood waters were swept away into a creek on Mockerson Road at Day Road. No injuries were reported.
lsr: CULVERT WASHED OUT WITH WATER OVER RABBIT TRAIL ROAD.
LOW WATER BRIDGE IMPASSABLE AT BISHOP CHAPEL ROAD NEAR SWEET HOME ROAD.
TWO VEHICLES IN CREEK, MOCKERSON ROAD AT DAY ROAD. OCCUPANTS ARE OUT OF THE VEHICLES.
